"""One-off generator for support/MC-406.json (issue trial-bmo)."""
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys

request = {
    "command": "statement",
    "release": "2.0",
    "lines": [
        {"line_id": "C-30", "account_id": "A", "subscription_id": "S1", "service_on": "2026-04-01", "charge_cents": 20000},
        {"line_id": "C-10", "account_id": "A", "subscription_id": "S2", "service_on": "2026-04-20", "charge_cents": 40000},
        {"line_id": "C-20", "account_id": "A", "subscription_id": "S1", "service_on": "2026-04-10", "charge_cents": 19999},
    ],
}

proc = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, "main.py"],
    input=json.dumps(request), capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=5,
)
response = json.loads(proc.stdout)

pathlib.Path("support").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
pathlib.Path("support/MC-406.json").write_text(
    json.dumps({"request": request, "response": response}, indent=2) + "\n"
)
print("fixture written; response:")
print(json.dumps(response, indent=2))
